integrity: Infinite-family proof supplied in RESULT.md, with exhaustive independent-implementation finite checks in verify_crown.py for the seven graph sizes from three through nine. Originality review is bounded by accessible indexed literature and is not an independent mathematical audit. The 1980 foundational theorem lacks a verified day-level public-source date; the stated date is the earliest day-verified version among the public primary-source identifiers, arXiv:1405.2486v1.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration of recurrent states for synchronous binary strict-neighbour majority with tie retention on labelled crown graphs with at least three matched pairs. It does not provide full transient-depth distributions, basin sizes, or claims for alternate update rules. A classical general period-two theorem is previously known.
title: A parity bifurcation in the recurrent-state census of crown-graph majority dynamics
